notes: Ceiling height 7.0m: user prior ~7m, confirmed by model-free beam parallax (x-baseline: z=7.10 corr 0.85; y-baseline: z=7.00 corr 0.94, see muontomo.beams) AND by the layered CV height scan once heights up to 7.4 were offered (cv_mean 2.48 @ 7.0 vs 2.80 @ 6.6; the earlier 6.6 choice was a CV local optimum). grid_spacing_m=0.08 (fine) required to resolve beam periodicity -- 0.15m aliased. layered_fit embeds the fitted layer across the z-voxels spanning layered_thickness. Beam positions in the reconstruction verified against raw per-detector transmission profiles (images/beam_verify.png): 5 beams, ~1.7m pitch, mean |offset| ~0.14m. tv_alpha=0.08 (swept 0.03-0.25): best beam accuracy (offset 0.10m vs 0.135 at 0.03), chi2 2.09, keeps all 5 beams; 0.25 over-regularizes (loses a beam, offset 0.45). Viewer display blur halved to 0.5*bin_footprint (~0.12m) since the stronger TV solve is already clean -- beams read as thin straight lines matching the single-detector 2D image instead of fat wavy blobs.
